headword: {耳鼻咽喉科|じびいんこうか}
gloss: ENT (ear, nose, and throat) department; otolaryngology

definitions.gloss: ENT (ear, nose, and throat) department; otolaryngology
definitions.explanation: The medical specialty and the corresponding department of a hospital or clinic that treats diseases of the ear, nose, throat, and adjoining areas of the head and neck. Patients visit it for problems such as ear infections, hearing loss, sinusitis, sore throat, hoarseness, dizziness, and hay fever.

examples.japanese: {耳鼻咽喉科|じびいんこうか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧きた。
examples.english: I went to the ENT clinic.

examples.english: Otolaryngology is a specialty that handles not only the ears, nose, and throat but also dizziness and tumors around the neck area.

notes:
Composed of {耳|じ} (ear), {鼻|び} (nose), ⟦{咽喉|いんこう}→咽喉：25204_inkou⟧ (throat; pharynx and larynx), and {科|か} (department; specialty). The English equivalent ENT (ear-nose-throat) is structurally identical, just shorter.

USAGE:
The full official name of the medical specialty and the corresponding hospital department, used on signage, prescriptions, insurance cards, and referral letters. In casual conversation it is very often shortened to ⟦{耳鼻科|じびか}→耳鼻科：22874_jibika⟧ ('ear-nose department'), which patients find easier to say. The shortened form is informal but completely standard. Some clinics now use even broader names like {耳鼻咽喉科|じびいんこうか}・{頭頚部外科|とうけいぶげか} (otolaryngology and head & neck surgery) on their nameplates.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {耳鼻咽喉科|じびいんこうか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to the ENT clinic
- {耳鼻咽喉科|じびいんこうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受診|じゅしん}→受診：11890_jushin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to see an ENT doctor
- {耳鼻咽喉科|じびいんこうか}{医|い}: ENT physician (otolaryngologist)
- {耳鼻咽喉科|じびいんこうか}⟦クリニック→クリニック：08941_kurinikku⟧: ENT clinic

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{耳鼻科|じびか}→耳鼻科：22874_jibika⟧: short, casual everyday form of the same word
- ⟦{内科|ないか}→内科：04076_naika⟧: internal medicine — a parallel medical department
- ⟦{眼科|がんか}→眼科：11071_ganka⟧: ophthalmology — another sense-organ specialty
- {頭頚部外科|とうけいぶげか}: head and neck surgery — a related, more surgical specialty often combined with ENT
